desc_src: Print out this image on a transparent film (The printer has to be fairly accurate) and cut out the two sheets. When these are moved against each other, a grid of black dots will appear. A zooming effect can also be performed by rotating one of the sheets.

Print out this image on a transparent film (The printer has to be fairly accurate) and cut out the two sheets. When these are moved against each other, a grid of white squares will appear. A zooming effect can also be performed by rotating one of the sheets.
